name: Proton VPN
author: Tharin Fernando
description: Proton VPN status, connect/disconnect, and server info in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Proton VPN status, connect/disconnect, and server info in the Omarchy bar.

schema.label: Status refresh while open (seconds)
schema.description: How often the panel asks the Proton CLI for status while it is open. Closed, the plugin only samples cheap network state and runs the CLI on changes (or every 10x this, at least 5 minutes).

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Show a notification when the VPN connects, disconnects, or fails.
